semantics.clock: All inputs sampled on rising clk edges. One serial bit per edge.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority; returns receiver to idle and clears done. No specified power-up state before reset.
semantics.receive: Idle high waits; idle low is start. Next eight edges are data regardless of value. Following edge samples stop.
semantics.completion: Valid high stop asserts done after that edge for one clock cycle. On next edge receiver can accept a low start, allowing consecutive frames.
semantics.recovery: Low expected stop produces no done. Ignore subsequent low bits until a high bit is sampled; that recovery high produces no done and returns to idle. Next edge may accept a new start.

numeric.payload: Eight data bits arrive least significant first but no payload output or storage is required.
numeric.arithmetic: Only unsigned 3-bit data-bit index 0 through 7; increment only below 7. No rounding, saturation, or numeric payload operations.

verification.oracle: Independent integer countdown model of start, eight data samples, stop, and recovery; compare done after every sampled edge.
directed: all 256 byte patterns with consecutive frames
reset during each frame position and recovery
synchronous reset does not affect output between edges
verification.random: Deterministic pseudo-random bits and reset pulses checked against countdown oracle.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 -g2012 explicit dev_tb top; compile and run each under finite timeout.

specification_ambiguities: The problem does not explicitly state pulse width or output phase; interpret done as a one-cycle indication immediately after sampling a valid stop bit.
Power-up state before a synchronous reset is unspecified.
